## F1 — File-prefilled model and effort are treated as given, so changing the agent keeps the old harness's choices

- Class: slip
- Confidence: high
- Where: `cmd/ploopy/settings.go:157`, `cmd/ploopy/board.go:228-237`
- Situation: `.ploopy.toml` has `[run] agent = "opencode"`, `model = "custom/model"`, `effort = "max"`; nothing else sets them. The board opens and the author changes the agent to claude with `a`.
- Happens: `givenSettings` sets `g.harness, g.model, g.effort` from the values after the file fallbacks, so all three read as given. `normalize` therefore keeps `custom/model` and `max` when the agent changes: the board shows claude with opencode's model and effort. Enter either starts claude with the foreign model or fails with `--effort for claude must be one of medium, high, xhigh`.
- Should: A file value is a prefill, not something given as a flag or in the plan. Changing the agent should reset model and effort to the new harness's defaults, as it already does for last-run values and as the Triage column does for the same file values (`triageDraft.given` holds only flags). The handover states that `given.from(key, source)` still means locked and `fromFile`/`prefilled` is the file path; that is not what the value-based assignment on line 157 does.
- Test: none exists. `TestChangingTheAgentKeepsAGivenModelOrEffort` covers flags only; `settings_file_test.go` never changes the agent.

## F2 — A file effort without its agent is validated late or under the wrong name

- Class: gap
- Confidence: high
- Where: `cmd/ploopy/settings.go:250-255` (check runs before `fill`), `cmd/ploopy/settings.go:291-311` (`fill` resolves the harness), `internal/config/config.go:162-172` (skips when `agent` is empty), `cmd/ploopy/triage.go:116-123` (review message)

- Should: §3 says validation happens where the flag is validated today, with the same messages naming the key instead of the flag. After the harness is resolved (last run or default), the file effort should be checked there and reported as `[run] effort` / `[review] triage_effort`.
